spec_match.rationale: Correctly teaches the LegacyNoInterfaceObject detection trap, but probes audioStartTime/audioEndTime instead of the specified speechStartTime/speechEndTime.

interactive.rationale: "Probe the surface" fills the static table; "Inspect a live result" starts a real recognition (stays listening in headless, no mic).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Framing matches, but the named attributes do not match the chromestatus summary.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes null (no timing) from unsupported and shows the failing detection recipe.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Suite is 8/8 BLOCKED (manual) and every assertion names audioStartTime/audioEndTime, but the spec PR #192 and Chromium's speech_recognition_result.idl define speechStartTime/speechEndTime — the suite cannot pass on a correct implementation. Immutable: needs a human decision, not an agent edit.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): static probe ran, live inspect started but could not complete without a microphone; console clean; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Use speechStartTime / speechEndTime — the names the spec and Chromium ship
openQuestions.detail: The pages (and the conformance suite) read result.audioStartTime / audioEndTime. web-speech-api PR #192 and chromium/src third_party/blink/renderer/modules/speech/speech_recognition_result.idl define speechStartTime and speechEndTime ([RuntimeEnabled=WebSpeechTimestamps], status stable on Win/Mac/Linux), as does the chromestatus summary. On a correct implementation the pages will report the feature absent. Rename in the demos; flag the immutable conformance.json for a human.

openQuestions.title: Replace the stale "not in Chromium main / no runtime flag" banner
openQuestions.detail: The banner says the attributes are not in Chromium main's IDL and no runtime flag exists (as of 2026-07-24). Both are now false: the IDL carries them behind WebSpeechTimestamps (stable on desktop, off on Android/ChromeOS). Update the banner with the real flag and platform availability.

openQuestions.title: Time out the live inspection with a clear message
openQuestions.detail: In a no-microphone environment the status sits at "Listening for one phrase… speak now" indefinitely; add a timeout/no-speech message and re-enable Inspect.

guidanceConsulted.query: speech recognition captions transcript live region accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose transcript/caption updates as text in a polite live region; keep start/stop as native buttons with clear state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Observed: captions/verdicts render as text lists with role=status; start/stop are native buttons.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "speech recognition captions transcript live region accessibility" (run 2026-11-15)

summary: Critique-only pass. Loaded http://localhost:3109/v153/speechrecognitionresult-timestamps-webspeech-api/capability-probe/ in Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass), clicked/changed every visible control, captured console errors and failed requests, checked 360px horizontal overflow and a Tab focus walk, and ran /v153/speechrecognitionresult-timestamps-webspeech-api/conformance/ (unflagged, and with the relevant --enable-blink-features flag where one exists). Non-minor work items are listed in openQuestions.
